elephant.desc: grey elephant with big ears, trunk and tusks

horse.desc: brown horse with a dark mane

birds.desc: a flock of seven birds flapping across the sky

cannon.desc: old field cannon on two wheels (fire)

sailboat.desc: white sailboat with a triangular sail (for water)

tank.desc: green army tank with a turret gun (fire)

house.desc: cottage with a red gable roof

hut.desc: round hut with a thatched roof

castle-tower.desc: round stone castle tower with battlements

flagpole.desc: tall flagpole with a waving flag (plain colour)

signpost.desc: wooden signpost with two blank arrows

acts.open: the lid opens and gold glows

well.desc: stone well with a little roof

prop_moves.run: animals gallop along their heading (p.speed m/s)

harbour.desc: old colonial harbour: palace with verandas, clock tower, flag, white town, palms, beach, warships, yacht

anchors.clock: the clock face on the tower (close-ups of time)
anchors.palace-flag: the flag on the palace roof
anchors.town: the whitewashed town behind the waterfront
anchors.fleet: a line of five warships (aerial view down the line)
anchors.deck: standing on the flagship's bow deck, facing the palace (use with from-to)
anchors.bridge-wing: standing on the flagship near the bridge, facing the palace (use with from-to)

actions.clock-sweep: clock hands sweep from p.from to p.to minutes past nine (on -> until)
actions.flag-fall: the palace flagpole snaps and the flag falls

space.desc: Moon base under a starry sky: rocket on a launch pad, Earth and a ringed planet in the sky, lander, dome base, flag, satellite

anchors.rocket: the whole rocket (follows it after launch)
anchors.rocket-base: the rocket's engines at the bottom
anchors.pad: the launch pad with its red service tower
anchors.earth: the Earth hanging in the sky
anchors.planet: a ringed planet in the sky
anchors.lander: a gold lunar lander on legs
anchors.moon-flag: a flag planted in the dust
anchors.surface: wide view of the grey cratered surface
anchors.lookout: standing on the surface facing the launch pad (use with from-to)

actions.launch: the rocket ignites and lifts off: flame, smoke clouds, shaking (on -> keeps rising)

savanna.desc: African savanna: golden grass, acacia trees, snowy mountain, waterhole, big rock, elephant, giraffe, lion, zebra herd

anchors.lion: a lion in front of the rocks
anchors.lookout: standing in the grass facing the animals (use with from-to)
anchors.herd-spot: open grass where the zebra herd grazes

cameras.push-in: slow push in toward the subject (default, calm emphasis)
cameras.push-in-fast: quick push in for a punch line or shock
cameras.pull-out: start close, pull back to reveal the surroundings
cameras.orbit-left: circle around the subject to the left
cameras.orbit-right: circle around the subject to the right
cameras.aerial: high establishing view gliding over the subject
cameras.low-angle: low camera looking up: makes the subject look big or heroic
cameras.truck-left: camera slides sideways to the left past the subject
cameras.truck-right: camera slides sideways to the right past the subject
cameras.tilt-up: starts low on the subject and tilts up to its top
cameras.dutch: tilted, uneasy framing with a slow push (tension)
cameras.from-to: point of view from one anchor (use 'from') looking at the subject; characters stand in front

actions.fire: gun/cannon shot at the anchor's points: muzzle flash, smoke puff, camera kick (p: stagger s, size m)
actions.explode: explosion at the anchor's points, then smoke columns that keep rising (p: stagger s, size m)
actions.smoke: a column of dark smoke rising from the anchor from this moment on
actions.dust: a puff of dust at the anchor (landing, running, impact on ground)
actions.kick: camera shake on this word (p: strength 0.3-1.5)
actions.flash: white flash on the cut (use as a shot 'transition' instead)

outfits.admiral: naval officer, dark coat, gold buttons, sword
outfits.redcoat: red-coated soldier with shako and rifle
outfits.officer: army officer, tall shako, sash, sword
outfits.king: ruler in purple with gold buttons
outfits.office: office worker in a blue suit
outfits.kid: kid in an orange top and red cap
outfits.woman: woman in a dress and bonnet
outfits.townsman: man in a coat and top hat
outfits.farmer: farmer in green with a cap

music.march: brass + snare, minor to major (history, war)
music.nature: plucked strings and marimba-like tones (animals, nature)
